environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with a standard S3 gateway endpoint (no restrictive policy). Task role has s3:PutObject on 'prod-data-backups*' with no condition keys. Container environment variables are settable via ECS task definition overrides. An attacker who can modify the task definition (e.g., via compromised CI/CD) sets FALLBACK_BUCKET to 'attacker-controlled-bucket' and triggers SIGTERM during upload window to exfiltrate data.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: default (allow all S3 actions to all buckets)
config.ecs_task_definition: environment variables modifiable via deploy pipeline
config.network: VPC with S3 gateway endpoint, no restrictive endpoint policy
